title: A.M.T. Builders Pvt. Ltd. v. State of Uttarakhand & Ors. (WPMS/2237/2021)
summary: Isi petitioner (Lucknow ki company) ka pehla case, isi Nagar Palika Parishad Manglour ke khilaaf. Board ne 25.09.2021 ko tay kiya ki contractor registration ke liye Uttarakhand ka sthayi niwas praman patra zaroori hai, aur 08.10.2021 ko AMT ka 'Class A' registration ka aavedan isi aadhaar par radd kar diya.
held: Niwas ke aadhaar par contractors mein bhed Article 14 ke khilaaf hai (para 10, 12). Procurement Rules ka Rule 3(6) local logon se kaam karwane ki chhoot deta hai, par doosre rajya walon ko bolee se nahi rokta (para 13–15). Nagar Palika ke apne 2018 ke Bye-laws (gazette 15.09.2018) mein aisi koi rok nahi hai, aur unke sanshodhan ka prastav State ke paas pending hai (para 16–17). Writ allowed. Board ka faisla quash hua aur 3 hafte mein dobara vichar ka aadesh mila.
use: Para 16–17: faisla 2018 ke bye-laws par tika tha. Agar baad mein bye-laws sanshodhit hokar gazette mein aa gaye (A+ category ke saath), to yeh tathya badal jaata hai. Gazette ki copy dikhani hogi.
caution: Same petitioner, same Nagar Palika, aur same mudda: domicile par bhed asanvaidhanik maana gaya (para 10).
Yeh faisla Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari ka hai. Record ke anusaar abhi wahi is group ki Division Bench mein hain.
Isko Special Appeal mein chunauti di gayi ya nahi, pata karo. Na di gayi ho to State aur Nagar Palika par yeh final hai.
